name: Lesson 30 · So, still, then: deshalb, trotzdem, dann; aber, sondern, denn, oder

cards.front: It's raining, so I'm **taking** an umbrella.
cards.back: Es regnet, deshalb **nehme** ich einen Regenschirm.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. deshalb takes the first place of its clause, so the verb comes next and ich after it.

cards.front: I'm tired, so I'm **going** to bed.
cards.back: Ich bin müde, deshalb **gehe** ich ins Bett.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. deshalb, then the verb, then the subject.

cards.front: He's ill, so he **isn't coming**.
cards.back: Er ist krank, deshalb **kommt** er nicht.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. deshalb: that's why. The verb right after it.

cards.front: He has to work tomorrow, so he **is getting up** early.
cards.back: Er muss morgen arbeiten, deshalb **steht** er früh **auf**.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. After deshalb the verb is second, and auf still goes last.

cards.front: The bus came late, so I **wasn't** on time.
cards.back: Der Bus ist spät gekommen, deshalb **war** ich nicht pünktlich.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. deshalb, war, ich.

cards.front: It's raining, **so** I'm taking the bus.
cards.back: Es regnet, **deshalb** nehme ich den Bus.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. deshalb gives the result; weil would give the reason: Weil es regnet, nehme ich den Bus.

cards.front: It's raining. Still, we're **going** for a walk.
cards.back: Es regnet. Trotzdem **gehen** wir spazieren.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. trotzdem: in spite of that. It takes the first place, so the verb follows it.

cards.front: The flat is expensive. Still, we **are buying** it.
cards.back: Die Wohnung ist teuer. Trotzdem **kaufen** wir sie.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. trotzdem, kaufen, wir. die Wohnung → sie.

cards.front: I'm tired, but I'm **working** anyway.
cards.back: Ich bin müde, aber ich **arbeite** trotzdem.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. trotzdem can also come after the verb; after aber, the order is normal.

cards.front: We were wet, but we **had** fun anyway.
cards.back: Wir waren nass, aber trotzdem **hatten** wir Spaß.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. aber does not count; trotzdem is first, so hatten comes next.

cards.front: First I shower, then I **have breakfast**.
cards.back: Zuerst dusche ich, dann **frühstücke** ich.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. zuerst and dann each take the first place: the verb follows them.

cards.front: First we pack the suitcase, then we **drive** to the station.
cards.back: Zuerst packen wir den Koffer, dann **fahren** wir zum Bahnhof.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. dann fahren wir: the verb straight after dann.

cards.front: First I **put on** my jacket, then I go.
cards.back: Zuerst **ziehe** ich meine Jacke **an**, dann gehe ich.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. zuerst first, the verb second, an at the end.

cards.front: Pack your suitcase, then we **can** go. (one friend)
cards.back: Pack deinen Koffer, dann **können** wir gehen.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. dann können wir gehen: the modal right after dann.

cards.front: After that we **are going** to the cinema.
cards.back: Danach **gehen** wir ins Kino.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. danach: after that. The verb follows it.

cards.front: The hotel is cheap; besides, it **is** quiet.
cards.back: Das Hotel ist billig, außerdem **ist** es ruhig.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. außerdem: what's more. It takes the first place, so ist comes next.

cards.front: I have no time. Besides, I **have** no money.
cards.back: Ich habe keine Zeit. Außerdem **habe** ich kein Geld.
cards.note: deshalb, trotzdem, dann: they take the first place, so the verb follows. Außerdem, habe, ich.

cards.front: I don't drink coffee, **but** tea.
cards.back: Ich trinke keinen Kaffee, **sondern** Tee.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. After a negative, but meaning instead is sondern, not aber.

cards.front: That isn't my rucksack, **but** my brother's.
cards.back: Das ist nicht mein Rucksack, **sondern** der Rucksack von meinem Bruder.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. nicht … sondern: not this, but that.

cards.front: He isn't coming by bus, **but** by bike.
cards.back: Er kommt nicht mit dem Bus, **sondern** mit dem Fahrrad.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. sondern corrects what was negated.

cards.front: The flat is small, **but** it's cheap.
cards.back: Die Wohnung ist klein, **aber** sie ist billig.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. aber stands outside the clause: sie ist, normal order.

cards.front: I'd like to come, **but** I have no time.
cards.back: Ich möchte kommen, **aber** ich habe keine Zeit.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. aber: but, with nothing negated to replace.

cards.front: I'm staying at home, **because** I'm ill.
cards.back: Ich bleibe zu Hause, **denn** ich bin krank.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. denn means because, but it keeps the normal order: ich bin, not ich krank bin.

cards.front: We're taking an umbrella, **because** it's raining.
cards.back: Wir nehmen einen Regenschirm, **denn** es regnet.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. denn es regnet: the verb stays second.

cards.front: She's eating now, **because** she's hungry.
cards.back: Sie isst jetzt, **denn** sie hat Hunger.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. denn + normal order; weil would send hat to the end.

cards.front: Are you coming along, **or** are you staying here? (one friend)
cards.back: Kommst du mit, **oder** bleibst du hier?
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. oder: or. The second question keeps its own order.

cards.front: Tea **or** coffee?
cards.back: Tee **oder** Kaffee?
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. oder between two words.

cards.front: We'll take the bus, **or** we'll walk.
cards.back: Wir nehmen den Bus, **oder** wir laufen.
cards.note: aber, sondern, denn, oder: they join without moving the verb. oder does not count as a position: wir laufen.
